## DCIM bounded change

### Task binding

- [ ] One task ID and one objective
- [ ] Exact base commit recorded
- [ ] Write allowlist and protected paths recorded
- [ ] Required inputs bound by SHA-256
- [ ] Network, sockets, dependency installation, publication, and Git-mutation capabilities declared

### Evidence and implementation

- [ ] Product delta is distinct from control artifacts
- [ ] No evidence-law, origin-floor, withholding, or privacy rule was silently changed
- [ ] Deterministic gates passed with machine-readable results
- [ ] Same-scope correction budget did not exceed two turns
- [ ] No `/tmp` or `/private/tmp` object is a later-stage dependency

### Verification and promotion

- [ ] Writer ran in a disposable worktree
- [ ] Read-only verifier rebound the exact frozen patch in a fresh worktree
- [ ] Canonical repository and protected-path invariants passed
- [ ] Execution, governance, and transport states remain separate
- [ ] Principal acceptance is still required before promotion
- [ ] No push, deployment, publication, source admission, purchase, or outreach is implied by technical PASS

### Drift guard

- [ ] No duplicate SHA-256 transfer was requested
- [ ] No unplanned verifier or `RESUME-*` recursion was introduced
- [ ] Every requested human action produced a product delta, deterministic result, evidence item, or principal decision
